📌 Concentrated Liquidity: Why LPs Choose Their Own Risk Zone

 Points
⏺️ Concentrated liquidity lets LPs place capital inside a selected price range
⏺️ It improves capital efficiency, but adds risk if price leaves the range
⏺️ This post explains how the mechanic works – and why it’s harder than a simple pool

1️⃣ Core Idea – LPs don’t spread liquidity across all prices; they choose a specific range.
2️⃣ Why It’s Efficient – capital works where trading actually happens, so fee income can improve.
3️⃣ Main Risk – if price leaves your range, your position stops earning fees and becomes mostly one asset.
4️⃣ IL Risk – strong trends can create more impermanent loss than in a basic pool.
5️⃣ Practical Rule – choose ranges based on pair volatility, monitor price, and rebalance when needed.

Final Thoughts

Concentrated liquidity gives LPs more control – and more responsibility. Yield depends not only on the pool, but on how well you pick the range.
